## Agreement acceptance

After you open the PR, the acceptance workflow adds a checkbox linked to the
agreement and your exact contribution. Read that declaration and check its box
using your own account. New commits require renewed acceptance.

Keep one language and one author per PR for automatic acceptance. Disclose any
other authors above so their rights can be reviewed separately. Do not post
private contact details or identity documents here.
